# Synthetic travel policy — version 1

Travel reimbursement requires receipts. The maximum approved hotel rate is 180 CAD per night.
The Finance owner reviews claims within five business days. This policy applies to the North team only.

The 2025 archived hotel rate was 150 CAD. Use version 1 for current claims.
